decision.instructions: Acting as the coverage reviewer, decide how the building water-damage portion of claim HX-2026-118804 must be settled under the policy form and the endorsements attached to the current term.

criteria.deny_repeated_seepage: The building water damage is excluded as repeated seepage or leakage (Exclusion 4.3) with no exception applying.
criteria.deny_vacancy_exclusion: The building water damage is excluded because the dwelling was vacant for more than 60 consecutive days before the loss (Exclusion 4.7).
criteria.pay_full_estimate_less_deductible: The loss is covered without any sublimit; the full estimate is paid after deducting the $1,000 deductible.
criteria.pay_subject_to_10000_sublimit: The loss is covered but payment is capped by the concealed-water sublimit of $10,000.
criteria.pay_subject_to_15000_sublimit: The loss is covered but payment is capped by the concealed-water sublimit of $15,000.
